source.scope: store-wide (NOT product-scoped) — an order belongs to Dilaksi if its the order matches Organic's rule (see below) AND contains one of Dilaksi's owned product IDs, EXCLUDING any Direct order whose 2nd session is Google Ads paid search (those go to Sajeepan/Sonya instead — per user request 2026-07-30). Checked after Kamsi (1 product ID appears in both lists as given by the user, resolves to Kamsi) and before Organic.. Order-level rows (no per-product breakdown) with full session history. Groups are checked in a fixed priority order (DM-Ad -> Meta -> Sonya -> Sajeepan -> Sukirtha -> Kamsi -> Dilaksi -> Organic) so no order can appear in more than one group's tab. 2025 backfill using the exact same rules already confirmed on salesuk.html for 2026 — built 2026-07-29.
